record.title: Review evidence-preserving capacity for the next guest experiment
record.intent: Identify a bounded reversible storage option without weakening the preboot gate or discarding evidence.
requirements: Inventory only relevant generated guest-run storage and available workspace capacity; keep all existing evidence and reference artifacts unchanged during this review.
Distinguish indexed raw evidence, disposable runtime disks, immutable backing inputs and derived host controls. Pin any proposed candidates and explain dependencies needed for exact restoration.

Prefer a verified lossless archival or independent storage option if available; do not lower the 2GiB gate merely to continue. Any replacement or removal must be separately admitted with restoration and byte-identity checks first.
Record a concrete capacity plan or genuine blocker. No archive replacement, deletion, guest launch, host policy change or physical access in this task.
acceptance: A concrete evidence-preserving capacity recommendation or exact blocker is committed.
